newsitem.title: USA: Benthos names Stephen Fantone chairman.
newsitem.headline: Benthos names Stephen Fantone chairman.

text.p: Benthos Inc said Thursday its board has elected Stephen Fantone chairman.
Fantone, who is founder and president of Optikos Corp, has been a director of Benthos since 1995.
He succeeds Samuel Raymond, founder of Benthos and chairman since 1985, the company said.
Raymond will now assume the title chairman emeritus and director of research, it said.
Benthos said its board also named Francis Dunne treasurer. Dunne was chief financial officer of Kinney Vacuum Co, a division of General Signal Corp, prior to his appointment, it said.
Optikos is a privately-held engineering firm that specializes in optical product design and instrumentation.

Benthos designs, makes, sells and services oceanographic and robotic equipment for underwater and exploration and research. It also makes TapTone inspection systems to test seals of containers made of glass, metal or plastic.
